did: Home now accepts interview takes as a voice note kind of their own, for both the question answers and the teleprompter reads. It keeps them, plays them back to your phone in My data, and files their transcripts to the mailbox for the week's routine. The mailbox change went live first, and the privacy invariants say so.

calls.title: How an interview take names what it was said for
options: <week>:<question> for answers and <week>:read:<card> for reads, week as Rust Rounds' YYYY-wNN, ids as slugs
Free-form ref, checked only by the generic rule
A separate kind for teleprompter reads
calls.why: Home refuses malformed refs at the door as it does for Rust Rounds, one kind keeps the shared graph, and the format was agreed with the phone's side and IW4's week ids
calls.undo: Change voice_repo::is_interview_ref and the phone's ref builder together; stored refs stay as they were
